title: HR Driver with Forklift Licence
summary:
We’re looking for a reliable HR Driver with a valid Forklift Licence to join our friendly team based in Woodridge. If you enjoy early starts, steady hours, and chatting with customers while out on the road—this could be the perfect fit!

The Detail

Hours: Monday to Friday, 5:30am – 2:00pm (plus overtime if you want it)
Pay: $39.00 per hour
Location: Woodridge
Type: Casual, ongoing work
What You’ll Be Doing
Delivering goods to both businesses and homes around the Brisbane area
Operating a truck-mounted forklift to unload goods
Using our GPS system (CIN7) to manage deliveries and routes
Interacting with customers in a professional and friendly way
Keeping things running smoothly and on time
What’s In It For You
Consistent hours and weekly pay
Work with a supportive, down-to-earth team
Opportunities to grow within the company
Modern delivery systems and equipment
A company that promotes from within
What You’ll Need
HR Licence
Forklift Licence (FL)
Good attitude and reliability
Comfortable chatting with customers and providing great service
Experience with deliveries is a bonus
Keen to get started?
Click “Apply Now” and send through your resume. We’re ready to welcome the right person into the team!
